Do not infer whole-plant silhouette, branching pattern, or internode spacing from this close-up reference.
CULTIVAR IDENTITY CONTEXT: Triangle Kush S1 by Humboldt CSI; S1/selfed generation; Triangle Kush × Triangle Kush.
PHOTOGRAPHIC CONSTRAINTS: photorealistic botanical reference photography; single mature female cannabis plant; complete plant visible; natural light; neutral non-distracting background; no text; no collage; no packaging; no smoke.
NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS: no fruit or berries; no people; no labels or logos; no jars, bags, boxes or bottles; no smoke; no unrelated objects; no fantasy anatomy; do not invent cultivar-specific whole-plant architecture where the reference does not show it.
